notes: The electric-start battery is not included with the unit.

gaps: The list has no OEM part numbers or per-part ratings.
The battery entry describes that requirement and has no quantity.
The spec table also mentions a non-replaceable CR2032 3 V cell without saying where it is, so it is left out.
method: Single source: Harbor Freight owner's manual for item 59206 (copyright 2022, manual code 24a); spec table and Components and Controls figure on page 7, battery setup on page 9, parts list on pages 25-26.

The parts list names the generator end 'Components Of Motor' (item 34), listed with a carbon brush set, motor terminal plate, rear motor end cover and a voltage regulator; 'Motor' in this list is read as the generator end.
The list gives reference numbers, names and quantities only.
The alternator's figures are the 'Generator' output rows of the spec table.
The manual only states which battery to fit.
The parts list names a part only as 'Sensor' (item 71); the CO sensor is claimed from the Components and Controls figure and the CO shutoff section, not from that item.

comps.spec: Engine (parts list item 66, qty 1): 420 cc horizontal single-cylinder 4-stroke OHV, forced-air cooled; spark plug NHSP / Torch F7TC, gap 0.028-0.031 in

'Components Of Motor' (item 34, qty 1) with a carbon brush set (item 35), motor terminal plate (item 36) and rear motor end cover (item 44); the spec table rates the generator output at 120/240 VAC 60 Hz, 60.4 A at 120 V or 30.2 A at 240 V, rated 7,250 W running (9,000 starting watts maximum)
Voltage Regulator (item 42), listed among the 'Motor' parts (items 34-44)

Not included with the generator: for electric start the manual calls for a 12 V sealed lead-acid battery, 9 Ah minimum (Thunderbolt #62586 named as one that fits), bolted into the generator's battery holder; the parts list has a storage battery pressing support and its connecting rods (items 72-73)
Starter Motor Component (item 150) for electric start
Starting Relay (item 151), listed with the starter motor
Coil Assy., Ignition (item 162); fires the Spark Plug (item 102), NHSP / Torch F7TC
Overcurrent Protectors (items 9 and 10, qty 1 each; item 11, qty 2); the control panel shows AC circuit breakers and a DC circuit breaker
Two 3-prong duplex 120 V GFCI receptacles, NEMA 5-20
CO sensor for the carbon monoxide shutoff, shown in the Components and Controls figure
Oil Level Sensor (item 135) with oil switch components (item 65) for the low-oil shutdown
Tank (item 64) with fuel gauge; recommended fill level 8 gallons
